_comment: THE ISO/IEC 1989:2002 8.10 CONTEXT-SENSITIVE WORD LIST (kb/Work PB4174), the one pre-2023 population this repository records: the words the 2002 standard lists in 8.10, transcribed from the post-ballot text ISO/IEC 1989:2002(E) of 2001-12-04 (P2 of kb/Work PB3602 'Sources': the register's durable copy fcd/v200112/cobolv200112.pdf, 8.10 on its printed pages 144-145). The words are facts; no text of the standard is held. scripts/gen-reserved-words.ps1 reads this file and the 2023 spec (8.10 and Annex E.3.3 item 13) and writes each word's introduction edition into ContextSensitiveWords.Table.cs and context-sensitive-words.json: 2002 for a word listed here; 2023 for a word E.3.3 item 13 says 2023 added and this list lacks; 2014 for every other 2023 8.10 word (the previous standard, E.1, lists the words it added, so a word 2023 does not call new was in 2014, and it was not in 2002). Cross-check (PB4174, 2026-10-31): the CD 1.2 of 2009-08-23 (P3) 8.10 lists a superset of these words and 14 of the 22 words this rule dates 2014. ContextSensitiveWordsDriftTests holds this file to the generated table. CONTENT-FILTER RULE: never print this file into a conversation.
